bio.text: Bo Whitehead is the Green Party candidate for North Carolina's 8th Congressional District in 2026.
WFAE's voter guide lists him as a 33-year-old warehouse supervisor who lives in Pineville and moved to the Charlotte area about three years ago from Georgia.
In the guide's questionnaire, he said he was homeschooled and received a GED.

sources.title: U.S. House of Representatives NC-8 Candidates
